description.en: Animated React components designed for developer ownership and fluid aesthetics.
description.zh: 追求 100% 开发者自主可控与流畅动效美学的 React 即拷即用现代组件库。

content.en: Sona UI is a design-first animated React component library built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Built on the philosophy of complete source code ownership, it provides polished dialogs, animated buttons, card carousels, and landing heroes designed to give websites distinct character.
content.zh: Sona UI 是一套以动效美感与完全代码所有权为导向的 React 组件库。借助 Tailwind CSS 与 Framer Motion，它为开发者奉上了打磨完善的弹窗浮层、呼吸感按钮、视差卡片轮播与落地页 Hero，所有组件皆可直接拷贝源码并随意自由定制。
